stem.text: An escalator is $60\,\text{m}$ long and lifts passengers through a vertical height of $30\,\text{m}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Drawing of an escalator with passengers standing on it, with its length labelled 60 m and its vertical height labelled 30 m.

stem.text: To drive the escalator against the forces of friction when there are no passengers requires a power of $2.0\,\text{kW}$.
The escalator is used by passengers of average mass $60\,\text{kg}$ and the power to overcome friction remains constant.
How much power is required to drive the escalator when it is carrying 20 passengers and is travelling at $0.75\,\text{m s}^{-1}$?
